summary: The media gtest suite gained coverage for VideoToolbox colorspace reporting, HDR metadata across remote shared memory, A/V clock drift, audio-graph shutdown and ordering, seek behavior, and time-stretched audio. It also tests video conversion, picture regions, odd-sized YUV buffers, encoder dimension and muted-frame handling, WebM cluster timing, GMP plugin visibility, and Apple VideoToolbox encoding, helping catch platform-specific regressions in playback, recording, and streaming.
